method: A scratch-only LRU over real esbuild contexts; synthetic cloned Crumbs recipe entries share one theme dependency; retained Node and esbuild-service RSS are sampled before and after explicit disposal.

protocol.hotEntryWorkingSet: up to four most-recently scanned entries
protocol.hotAccessPattern: entry-0, entry-1, entry-0, entry-2, entry-0, entry-1, entry-3
protocol.memorySampling: Node process.memoryUsage() plus read-only ps RSS for esbuild service children of the worker; RSS values are snapshots, not per-context allocation measurements.
protocol.outputParity: Every distinct cached entry/value result is compared after cache disposal to a fresh @vanilla-extract/integration compile by exact generated JavaScript SHA-256 and normalized input receipt.
protocol.cache: Scratch-only Map-based LRU; all hits still call context.rebuild(); misses create a context; eviction and close await context.dispose().
protocol.rawRecordCompaction: Per-process output hashes and a receipt-set SHA-256 are retained; normalized input lists are stored once per entry-count and entry. Inputs are cross-checked exactly across processes. Output hashes remain per-process because Vanilla Extract embeds each unique temporary fixture path. Per-request timing arrays and lifecycle/memory samples remain intact.

limits: The stylesheet-count workload clones one small recipe fixture and a shared theme; it is synthetic and is not a Metro transform trace from a production application.
The scratch LRU is not production code and does not prove Crumbs full-transform, Metro worker shutdown, Node 22 host-budget, Hermes, device, or Android behavior.
RSS snapshots include the esbuild service process and allocator high-water effects; they do not isolate bytes retained by each live context.
